stem: Formative diagnostic check 7: A symptom appears only on one cultivar in two rooms but not on other cultivars sharing those rooms. Which observation most changes the next diagnostic step?
choices: The cultivar is proven genetically defective.
The repeated cultivar association increases the value of comparing genotype/developmental response with shared environmental and root-zone evidence.
No additional environmental or root-zone data are needed.
rationale: A repeated cohort association is useful evidence but does not by itself prove a genetic cause or eliminate shared-system contributors.
